# Country scope. Non-BYZ Yuan / Mongol East Asian realm.
oe_est2_is_yuan_realm = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ }
	OR = {
		tag = CHI
		tag = YUA
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
	}
}

	}
}

# Country scope. Non-BYZ Japan (Shogunate, Courts, Daimyo, or Japanese culture group).
oe_est2_is_japan_region = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ }
	OR = {
		tag = JAP
		tag = ASK
		tag = STC
		tag = NTC
		tag = ODA
		tag = YMT
		tag = HSK
		tag = TKD
		tag = UES
		tag = SMZ
		tag = MRI
		tag = OTM
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Building-based Japanese Shogunate daimyo clan.
oe_est2_is_shogunate_building_daimyo = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	country_type = building
	exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
	is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
}

# Country scope. True when an armed estate (nobles, tribes, or cossacks) is critically restless or country is in crisis.
oe_est2_has_restless_armed_estate = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		AND = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value < 0.35 }
				stability < 0
				war_exhaustion >= 8
				is_during_bankruptcy = yes
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = estate_type:tribes_estate value < 0.35 }
				stability < 0
				war_exhaustion >= 8
			}
		}
		AND = {
			country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = estate_type:cossacks_estate value < 0.35 }
				stability < 0
				war_exhaustion >= 8
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. True if any estate currently holds unraised private regiments.
oe_est2_has_any_private_regiments = {
	any_estate = {
		estate_unraised_regiment_count >= 1
	}
}

# Country scope. Lightweight host filter for yearly living estates & banking event dispatch.
oe_est2_is_living_estates_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		oe_est2_is_major_building_bank_or_league = yes
		tag = CHI tag = YUA tag = MNG tag = MCH tag = KOR
		tag = JAP tag = ASK tag = ODA tag = STC tag = NTC
		tag = TUR tag = MAM tag = BYZ
		tag = MOS tag = RUS tag = NOV tag = POL tag = PLC
		tag = FRA tag = ENG tag = GBR tag = CAS tag = SPA
		tag = HAB tag = BRA tag = PRU tag = BOH tag = AUG
